title: A Wolf for the Thorn
author: Marguerite Thackeray
blurb: Coral Zhou, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
